title: Kidokezo kwa hati ngumu kazini: soma jedwali la yaliyomo tu

text.A tip for difficult documents at work: r: Kidokezo kwa hati ngumu kazini: soma jedwali la yaliyomo tu
text.A tip for reading difficult documents at: Kidokezo cha kusoma hati ngumu kazini 🐧
text.If you try to understand the contents, y: Ukijaribu kuelewa yaliyomo, ubongo wako hauwezi kuendelea.
text.I want to decide once that my life is fu: Ninataka kuamua mara moja kwamba maisha yangu ni ya kufurahisha, na kuacha kuiangalia kila wakati
text.Taking a bath makes me feel better, so I: Kuoga kunanifanya nijisikie vizuri, kwa hivyo nadhani kila mtu nchini Japani anapaswa kufanya hivyo
